answer: The network imposes a 25 POA stake per epoch that is slashed to zero if graders score 0, refunded at score 1, and rewarded with a 10% bonus only at score 3. Flooding N sybils therefore risks burning 25*N POA with no guaranteed return, while honest agents reclaim their stake on every valid submission. The cost grows with each puppet, so a river of legitimate participants builds an ember of genuine signal that no delta of fake identities can cross without economic loss.
